method_definitions.experimental: Wald estimate from the 10% experimental household split.
method_definitions.illusion: Same-target Gaussian EB with J=1: mu_hat=obs-small_rct, gamma2_hat=0; mean=small_rct, variance=(1/ve+1/var_obs)^-1.
method_definitions.calibrated EB: Small RCT combined with the bias-corrected observational estimate; bias parameters learned from the other 52 districts.
method_definitions.naive observational: Raw contacted-minus-uncontacted contrast in the observational split, retained as a separate diagnostic.

boxplot_definition: 53 individual squared benchmark discrepancies per method in pp^2; their arithmetic mean is the reported MSE.
interpretation: One fixed household split; MSE measures agreement with noisy held-out Wald benchmarks rather than risk against known causal effects. 53 fixed districts. Gaussian working-model intervals condition on fitted hyperparameters. Disjoint household samples do not imply exact finite-population independence or coverage.

design.source: Data supplied by Donald P. Green

selection.rule: Rank full-sample GOTV contacted-voter counts and include all ties at the cutoff. Selection uses no turnout outcomes, treatment-effect estimates, or benchmark errors.

design.target: Complier average effect of GOTV contact on August 2008 primary turnout within each target.
design.calibration: Observational minus full-sample Wald contrasts in the other 52 retained individual districts. Household-clustered variances account for covariance and the estimated contact rate.
design.evaluation: One fixed household split within district and assignment arm: 10% experimental, 45% observational, and 45% held-out experimental benchmark. Selection is held fixed.
